notes:
Status: Closed-lost / chose self-host. CRM notes and call fragments below - shorthand common.
- Customer repeatedly: 'control over GPU stack and cost per token is our priority.'
- Security team insisted on air-gapped runbooks, HSM-backed keys, and full audit trails; they were skeptical of hosted cross-tenant compute.
- POC gave good perf but infra team pushed for TGI + vLLM to reduce per-token spend and to use existing on-prem GPUs with TensorRT optimized kernels.
- Internal champion: Head of AI (Tariq) left company in Jan; momentum slowed and no new exec sponsor.
- Lost to internal decision to self-host (stack choices called out: vLLM for scheduler and batching, TGI for model serving, TensorRT-LLM/Triton for kernel acceleration).
- AE notes: propose lightweight re-engagement packet (migration pathways from self-host -> Redwood private, hybrid patterns, migration credits).
- SE notes: captured infra constraints and steps to make hosted acceptable (custom kernel attestation, extended SOC artifacts).
Quoted excerpts: "can't risk vendor kernels; we need Triton+TensorRT profiles" — Security lead.
Short-term posture: customer stand-up on Kubernetes with on-prem Triton, using vLLM as scheduler; plan to keep stack in-house and revisit vendor solutions after 6-12 months or if scale economics worsen.
